# Inappropriate use of intravenous epinephrine leading to atrial fibrillation during prehospital anaphylaxis treatment: a case report\n\nHaewon Jung, Hyun Wook Ryoo, Jungbae Park\n\n## Abstract\n\nA 46-year-old man presented with severe anaphylactic symptoms. An additional intravenous bolus of epinephrine was administered and led to atrial fibrillation. Intravenous epinephrine is not typically recommended without continuous monitoring.\n\n## INTRODUCTION\n\nEpinephrine is a first-line drug for anaphylaxis, but concentrations above the therapeutic range can cause ventricular arrhythmias and myocardial infarction.\n\n## CASE REPORT\n\nThe patient developed atrial fibrillation after intravenous administration.
